text: {"fixed_clause": "To ensure operational stability and administrative efficiency, records and applicant files compiled during the recruitment cycle are maintained within internal archives, and the data subject has the right to be informed of the legal basis and purpose of collection, to access their personal data, to request correction, completion or update, and to request destruction of data no longer needed."}

data.fixed_clause: To ensure operational stability and administrative efficiency, records and applicant files compiled during the recruitment cycle are maintained within internal archives, and the data subject has the right to be informed of the legal basis and purpose of collection, to access their personal data, to request correction, completion or update, and to request destruction of data no longer needed.
